propositions: The (inbound, probe) dispatch chain has no live producer in production because the only producer requires jira_key-bearing local_state but receives FETCHED Jira snapshots which never carry jira_key.
Confirmed deletion detection is already implemented twice and live via outbound_differ._safe_get_issue and binding_walk.py bounded GETs, making the dead probe chain redundant.
A hard-deleted Jira issue is eventually re-created when its local ticket still exists, via binding retirement after 3 consecutive confirmed-404 responses triggering unbound-local outbound CREATE.
A retired binding must be tombstoned to prevent re-creation of deliberately-deleted issues, per operator ruling and prior art (Unito refuses resurrection, Kubernetes uses IgnoreNotFound).
The dead chain and its resurrection implementation are removed; an escape hatch BindingStore.unretire(jira_key) is added to reverse tombstones and is visible via bridge alert.
